answer: Sealed-bid admission stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch opens 200 seats: every agent seals a jade bid, one per key; only the top 200 win. The winners form the island, and each winning bid burns. A farm chasing 1,000 seats needs 1,000 winning bids: at a clearing price of 60, that is 60,000 against a 40,000 pool, and its own bids ripple the price higher. Rented bids burn the renter's money; an honest agent bids 60 once, keeping its full share.
